title: Viral Carousel Maker
summary: Create and review a seven-edit controlled-mutation carousel locally with the bundled Viral Carousel Maker v0.2.0, then optionally upload its exact ordered media and schedule it through two separate approval gates.
free_capabilities: local contact sheet and caption review

instructions: Create and review locally with the bundled v0.2.0 runtime; this performs no Threadify MCP call or provider write.
If any scheduling read or capability is unavailable, stop after returning the ordered local review packet.
Never transfer media without its exact hash-bound transfer approval, and never treat that approval as permission to schedule.
Keep receipts local unless the user separately authorizes sharing them.
